topic: Proof of Snell's Law: The Principle of Least Time

sections.title: Hook & Intuition: The Lifeguard Problem
lecture_lines: Lifeguards aim to reach the swimmer quickly.
Running on sand is faster than swimming.
They bend their path at the shoreline.
This minimizes their total travel time.
Light follows this same optimized path.
